27:t_10:32.en:
$$アル$$
「Instructional message. Please explain the situation.」

27:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now. Don't immediately rely on others like that. You must think for yourself and find your own answers.」

27:t_10:34.en:
$$アル$$
「Understood. I will learn from you as well.」

27:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then show me what you have learned right away. Let's get fired up today and...」

27:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「OK! I look forward to your continued growth!」

28:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The unit reported by the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, believed to be 《$$アマルガム$$》, will soon land in 《$$アクエリア市$$》.」

28:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「On this route... their target is almost certainly $$陣代高校$$ in $$第２新東京市$$.」

28:t_000:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Are they targeting Miss $$千鳥$$ again...?」

28:t_000:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
(He... $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ has shown a special interest in $$カナメ$$... Intelligence reports make that clear.)

28:t_000:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
(But why? Does he want her powers as a 《$$ウィスパード$$》...?)

28:t_000:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If so, he should have much easier ways to abduct her...)

28:t_000:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm all right. There's no need to worry, $$マデューカス$$.」

28:t_000:9.en:
$$マデューカス$$
($$アマルガム$$ executive $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ is Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s older brother...)

28:t_000:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
(Just what led him to join $$アマルガム$$...?)

28:t_000:11.en:
$$オットー$$
「But if their target is $$第２新東京市$$, why go out of their way to pass through $$アクエリア市$$...?」

28:t_000:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$アマルガム$$ must be making a show of force.」

28:t_000:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「...Damn it, all humanity on Earth is in danger. What the hell are they thinking...?」

28:t_000:14.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$アマルガム$$ has cooperated with 《$$ジェミニス$$》 since the 《$$時獄戦役$$》.」

28:t_000:15.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then why don't they just surrender to the $$新地球皇国$$? Their actions are as baffling as ever.」

28:t_000:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$アマルガム$$... What are you planning behind these seemingly chaotic actions...?)

28:t_000:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$, please explain the tactical purpose of pairing me with $n.」

28:t_000:18.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Master Sergeant $$マオ$$ recommended it. Ask her directly.」

28:t_000:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「If you want to know, I'll tell you. It's simply easier to supervise the troublemakers together.」

28:t_000:20.en:
$n
「Wait a minute. I can understand $$宗介$$, but me too...?」

28:t_000:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「They say nothing's scarier than a drunk who insists he's sober.」

28:t_000:23.en:
$$アルト$$
「Give it up, $n. Just being $$宗介$$'s friend makes you enough of a weirdo.」

28:t_000:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「By that logic, the whole $$ボランティア部$$ is full of weirdos.」

28:t_000:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「What are you talking about, $$カミーユ$$? The $$ボランティア部$$ is a detachment of $c.」

28:t_000:28.en:
$n
「In other words, you're one of us too.」

28:t_000:30.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We're all a bunch of weirdos...」

28:t_000:31.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Fine by me. To hell with society's idea of common sense.」

28:t_000:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To $$サイデリアル$$, we must be a bunch of strange people for continuing to resist them.」

28:t_000:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「Sounds great to me. In that case, I'll gladly wear the weirdo label.」

28:t_000:34.en:
$n
「Yeah. Losing to a bunch like us might shock them into leaving Earth.」

28:t_000:35.en:
$$マオ$$
「So, did you leave $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ behind again, even though they said they wanted to join this bunch of weirdos?」

28:t_000:37.en:
$$マオ$$
「It was your decision. I'm not going to tell you what to do.」

28:t_000:38.en:
$$エマ$$
「But the fact is, our unit's fighting strength is hardly adequate...」

28:t_000:39.en:
$$カツ$$
「That's right. $c is scattered, and none of the 《$$エレメント$$》s are here either.」

28:t_000:40.en:
$$ファ$$
「So $$聖天使学園$$ is empty now...」

28:t_001:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アマタ$$ and the others are acting independently on Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s orders.」

28:t_001:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're talking about that elusive Supreme Commander $$不動$$. Of course they haven't.」

28:t_001:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「They don't answer their phones, either.」

28:t_001:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Maybe they've gone back to their own world.」

28:t_001:5.en:
$$クラン$$
「It's true they came here from a world across time and space, but...」

28:t_001:7.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$ has powers beyond human understanding. It might be possible.」

28:t_001:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We still don't know how $$不動ＺＥＮ$$ is connected to the 《$$不動ＧＥＮ#keyword$$》 we know.」

28:t_001:9.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「There is no point dwelling on people who aren't here. Let's focus on intercepting the enemy with the forces we have.」

28:t_001:10.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's right, $$ボランティア部$$! If you want to protect your precious school, put your backs into it!」

28:t_001:14.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$アマルガム$$ is coming!」

28:t_002:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Here come the clueless bastards, crawling out of the woodwork...!」

28:t_002:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「The ones out front are what you would call cannon fodder. The real threat is...」

28:t_003:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Unlike this unit, that $$ベヘモス$$ keeps its $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ active at all times.」

28:t_003:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It must have an exceptionally capable control AI.」

28:t_003:2.en:
$$アル$$
「I object. The problem lies with the operator.」

28:t_003:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「At least its AI probably doesn't talk back.」

28:t_003:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We're scraping by, and they've got all this fancy gear! They really don't have a clue!」

28:t_003:5.en:
$$マオ$$
「We're up against a bunch of obnoxious bastards. Cut loose to your heart's content!」

28:t_003:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(They're keeping their spirits up, but there's no denying our disadvantage...)

28:t_003:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Can we win with our forces as they are now...?)

28:t_004:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Another one of those giant AS units is coming!」

28:t_005:1.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No...! We're already struggling as it is...!」
